lac-2024.notes: Source 2 is a BOCA page of Programadores de America 2024 (PdA) that also carries regional and CCL views of the same board; the pack date (2024-03-19) differs from the problem set cover date (2024-03-17).

sources.evidence: BOCA 'Final Scoreboard' page titled 'Programadores de América 2024 - PdA' with 40 team rows and cells for problems A to L.
Table of 40 team rows with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation under the heading 'The 2024 ICPC Latin America Championship'.
23-page PDF whose cover reads 'Contest Session March 17, 2024' and whose page footers read 'The 2024 ICPC Latin America Championship' with problems A to L.
Codeforces gym dashboard 'The 2024 ICPC Latin America Championship' with a table of problems A to L whose names match the catalogue.

lac-2025.notes: Source 2 (Codeforces gym board) has 53 rows: 49 bracket-tagged teams (9 of them [CCL]), and 4 handle-named teams with no ghost icon, which hold places 1, 2, 5 and 18. Pack date 2025-03-17 differs from the problem set cover date 2025-03-16.

lac-2026.notes: Source 2 lists 40 teams and source 3 lists 41; the team in 20th place in source 3 is absent from source 2. Source 1 mixes 11 CCL teams with the 41 championship teams and shows each championship team twice.

Table of 41 teams with Rank, Team, Institution, Solved, Time and Citation columns and no per-problem cells.
